book.name: Luqaasa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Luqaasi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Am7ey Imota
Yesusi dhoqqu gi xeellishin dure asati Xoossa Keeththen muxuwaata izan shiishshizayssa giddon muxuwaata yeggishin be7ides.
Qasseka issi am7o dizaara nam7u sikkina gidiza nam7u xarqimala he muxuwaata izan shiishshizayssan yeggishin xeellidi,
«Ta inttes tumu gays; hanna am7eya ubba asaappe bollara aadheth immadus.
Hayti asati immiday baas diza tirpafe gidishin iza gidikko baas baynda wolqqaafe baas dizaaronne ba duussas koshshizaaro wursa yeggadus» gides.
Xoossa Keeththi Laalettanayssa Yesusi Kaseti Yootida Qaala

Iza kaallizaytappe issi issi asati Xoossa Keeththay lo7o shuchchaninne asay immida imotan ay mala lo7i keexettidaakko giidi ba giddon haasayettishin Yesusi siyidi, «Hayssi intte be7izayssi wuri laalettontta shuchchi shuchcha bolla keelettida mala attontta wodey yaana» gides.
Isttika iza, «Astamaaree! Hayssi wuri ayde hananee? Qasse hayssi hananayssas malatay aazee?» giidi oychchida.
Izikka isttas, «Intte balettontta mala naagettite; daroti bana, ‹Ta Kirstoosakko! Wodeykka matides› gishe ta sunththara yaana shin intte istta kaallofte.
Ola gishshassinne dere makkallateththa gishshas siyiza wode dagammofte. Hessi wuri kasetidi hananaas bessees; wurseththi gakkides; gido attiin heerakka hanenna» gides.
Qasse, «Derey dere bolla, kawoy kawo bolla dendana.
Biittay wolqqama qaath qaaxxana; koshaynne boshay dumma dummason hanana; daro babisizaazinne saloppe gita malatay beettana.

«Hessi wuri hananaappe kasetidi asay inttena oykkananne gooddana; Ayhuda Woosa Keeththinne qasho keeth gelththana; kawota sinththinne daannata sinth shiishshana. Hessi wuri ta sunththa gishshas intte bolla gakkana.
Hessi wurikka markkattanaas lo7o qaada gidana.
Hessa gishshas nuna oychchizaytas nu ay zaarinoo? giidi kasetidi hirgontta mala hayssa wozinan woththite.
Intte morkketappe oonikka inttenara eqettanaassinne baleththanaas dandayontta qaalanne cinccateth ta inttes immana.
Inttena yelidaytinne intte ishati, intte dabbotinne intte laggeti wuri inttena aaththi immana; inttefe baggata wodhana.
Ta sunththaa gishshas ubba asaa achchan intte ixettana.
Gido attiin intte hu7e binanatappe issinakka dhayukku.
Intte minni eqqiko intte shempo ashshana.
Yesusi Yerusalaame Dhayo Gishshas Kasetidi Yootida Qaala
«Ola asay Yerusalaame giddoththishin beyikko izis dhayza wodey matidayssa erite.
He wode Yuhudan dizayti pude zuma bolla gangetto; kataman dizaytikka katamappe kezite; dere giddon dizaytikka he katamayo geloppetto.
Xaafettidayssi wuri polettanaas hanna halo kessiza wode.
Biitta bolla gita metoy hanana; hayssa dereza bolla hanqoy yaana; hessa gishshas he wode qanththara diza maccassatassinne dhanththiza aayetas aayye ana!
Bagga asay mashshan hayqqana; ba dereppe hara dere di7ettana; Yerusalaameykka Xoos erontta dereta wodey polettana gakkanaas, Xoos erontta asatan yedhettidaaro gidana.
Asa Naas Nam7anththo Yuus
«Arshe bolla, agina bollanne xoolintte bolla malatay beettana; abbaafenne abba dambala giirissafe dendidayssan biitta bolla diza derey hirgananne metotana.
Salo wolqqamati qaaxxiza gishshas asay biitta bolla aazee hananeeshaa guussaninne naagon xalla daaburana.
He wode Asa Nay wolqqara, gita bonchchoranne shaarara yishin beyana.
Intteka hayti ha ta gidayti poleteth oykkishin inttes ateththa wodey matida gishshas sitti gi eqqite; intte ayfe pude dhoqqu histtite» gides.
Godaa Yuussaa Malatiza Balase Miththay Leemiso
Kaaleththidi, «Balase miththinne hara miththata ubbaa xeellite; he miththati hayth kessishin intte be7iza wode boney matidayssa intte ereeta.
Hessaththoka haytanti geetettidayti polettishin intte be7iza wode Xoossa Kawoteththi intteko matidayssa erite.
«Ta inttes tumu gays; hayssi wuri polettana gakkanaas ha yeletay aadhdhenna.
Saloynne sa7ay aadhdhana shin ta qaalay aadhdhenna.
«Histtiko wogay baynda duussan, daro ushshaninne duussas hirgan intte wozinay daaburoppo; hessa ooththontta ixxiko he gallassay intte qoppontta narxa mala intte bolla gakkontta mala naagettite.
Hayssi biitta bollan diza asaa ubbaa bolla gakkana.
Hessa gishshas buro yaanayssafe intte kessi ekkana malanne Asa Naa sinththan eqqanaas dandayana mala ubba gallas minnidi woossite» gides.
Yesusi gallas gallas Xoossa Keeththan tamaarsi tamaarsidi omars omars Dabrazayte geetettiza zuma bolla kezi kezi aqees.
Asay wurikka izappe siyanaas maalado wonttara Yesusaakko Xoossa Keeththe yees.
